title: Cross-team engineering leadership weekly staff notes - 2026-05-25
content:
Attendees: Ava Martinez (chair), Liam Chen, Priya Kapoor, Marcus Lee, Elena Gomez, SRE reps (Tom Huang), Solutions Eng lead (Sana Iqbal)

Agenda:
- Quick wins / shoutouts
- Incidents & reliability updates
- Serving runtime perf and quantization experiment updates
- Dedicated capacity / autoscaler status
- Private deployment (VPC) rollout checklist
- Rollouts / canaries / fallback policies
- Open blockers & actions

Notes / discussion:
1) Quick wins / shoutouts
- Team shipped the kernel selection refactor for xformers path on A100s — 10-15% p99 token latency improvement on long-context workloads. (Thanks Marcus + infra QA)
- Small but important: prefix-caching memory leak fix merged (PR #512). Verified on staging with synthetic traffic.

2) Incidents & reliability
- Incident on 2026-05-22: degraded throughput in us-west-2 for hosted-api due to autoscaler thrash when spot capacity reclaimed. Root cause: autoscaler mis-evaluating cold-start time for quantized 4-bit models. Mitigation: temporary cap on scale-down rate + more conservative backlog threshold. (SRE -> Tom)
- Action: add a postmortem ticket ENG-1024 (owner: Tom, due 2026-05-28). Include cost impact estimate and customer-facing blurb.

3) Serving runtime perf / quantization experiments
- Applied-ML update (Priya): 4-bit quantization on Llama2-70B-equivalent shows 1.9x throughput vs FP16 with minimal quality delta on our prompt set. Early results are promising but some failure modes in instruction-heavy generative flows (hallucination rate up ~1.5%).
- Decision: continue experiment but gate automatic rollout; require evals on production prompt set and a safety check. Priya to file a checklist for pre-rollout evals (due 2026-06-04).
- Marcus: kernel selector now supports dynamic sequence-length histograms; need to run full fleet simulation to pick default kernel policies. Request: infra to allocate 24h of smoke capacity (ticket LINKED: github PR and internal infra request).

4) Dedicated capacity / autoscaler status
- Dedicated customers: two new contracts in legal review; onboarding expected June. Need to validate SLA dashboards (latency SLOs per customer) before enrollment.
- Autoscaler: ongoing work to make scale decisions aware of model-variant compatibility (e.g., fallback to cheaper quantized variant during capacity shortfall). SRE to review canary config for this behavior.

5) Private deployment (VPC) rollout checklist
- Checklist updates (Ava): include KMS onboarding steps, audit-log retention levels, and network security group templates. Also add a preflight runbook for customers with on-prem hardware (esp. older GPU drivers).
- Action: Sana to coordinate a dry-run with Professional Services (target date 2026-06-10).

6) Rollouts / canaries / fallback policies
- Rollouts: Product requested a slower ramp on model-variant rollouts (canary 10% -> 25% -> 50% with 24h windows) after recent mini-regressions. Engineering agreed; update rollout service defaults.
- Fallback policy: add observable that tracks quality regressions tied to rollout cohorts (prompt-set based). Priya + DevExp to prototype by 2026-06-07.

7) Metrics / telemetry gaps
- Observability: need token-level cost attribution for Dedicated customers when multi-tenant scheduling is used — Finance asked for clearer breakout before next billing cycle. Action: Elena + SRE to propose schema by 2026-06-02.

8) Open blockers / escalations
- Blocker: CI flakiness for integration tests that run long-context end-to-end on the nightly cluster. CI team to investigate; temporary skip on the flaky suite approved. Owner: Liam (ETA 2026-05-29).
- Blocker: quantized-kv-cache edge-case causing incorrect completions with long prefix reuse (internal ticket ENG-1031). Requires combined eng + applied-ml debug session. Owner: Marcus & Priya (session scheduled 2026-05-26).

Action items (owner / due):
- Tom: write incident postmortem for 2026-05-22 autoscaler thrash (ENG-1024) / due 2026-05-28
- Priya: pre-rollout eval checklist for 4-bit quant models / due 2026-06-04
- Marcus: run fleet kernel-sim and propose default kernel policy / due 2026-05-31
- Liam: investigate CI flakiness and re-enable stable subset / due 2026-05-29
- Ava: update private deployment checklist + share with PS / due 2026-05-28
- Elena: propose token-level billing schema for Dedicated customers / due 2026-06-02
- Sana (Solutions Eng): schedule dry-run w/ PS for VPC onboarding / due 2026-06-10

Parking lot / topics for next week:
- Discussion on cost-control guardrails for autoscaler (rate-limits, budget-aware scaling)
- Longer-term: multi-region KV cache coordination (tradeoffs + consistency model)
- Scheduling: plan for expanded quantized-variant trials in EU region

Quick notes for docs / links to add to the meeting record:
- Include link to PR #512 and kernel-selection RFC draft in Confluence page.
- Add short blurb for customer success: two Dedicated contracts in legal review (send heads-up to account leads).

Misc / notes to self:
- Watch for telemetry drift after prefix-caching fix; schedule a 48h spike test after next deploy.
- Follow up with infra infra-cost team on spot capacity strategy (Tom + Marcus).

Next meeting: 2026-06-01 09:30 PT
